answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 26 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The river register is checked at draw time, terrace lists the eligible set, and quartz seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 26 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone burns for every seat it wants. The deposit is 42 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
